acceptedWorkstreams.title: Alt text from a real image audit, plus an image sitemap and the WebP conversion
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Twenty-two of the twenty-six images on the homepage and pricing pages carry alt text today, and most of it is accurate, so the gain here is precision rather than volume. I audited all 122 image instances across the nine marketing pages on 22 Oct 2026. The defects are specific: the whiteboard icon is labelled 'Assignments icon' and the AI class notes icon is labelled 'Ai Agents icon' on both product pages, the file-management icon is labelled 'Channels icon' on /products/file-management, the bootcamp hero says 'school workspace' on the bootcamps page, the Buzz hero says 'Zedu channels product screenshot', the logo is labelled 'Logo' on every page, /images/homepage/socials-row.png is labelled with its own file name, and the store badges are labelled 'App store' and 'Play store' rather than as the action they perform. Alongside the alt text, the same audit found the performance problem: those 26 files total 3,657 KB, of which 22 are PNGs making up 99.9 percent of the weight. The hero alone is 787 KB at 1883 by 1268 pixels. Deliverable: a per-image table of current alt, recommended alt and a flag for decorative images to receive empty alt, the image sitemap, and the WebP conversion plan with real byte sizes.

upvotes.reason: Auditing the real images first, then writing alt text, adding an image sitemap and converting to WebP is a sensible one-pass plan that does not invent descriptions.

The home page uses file-name alt text such as alt="socials-row" and alt="a wavy svg background for style" (checked 22 Oct 2026), and the WebP part is well founded: /images/homepage/solutions/bootcamp-example.png alone is 2,880,599 bytes and files/image-1.png is 1,332,300 bytes as PNG.

The image audit identifies specific incorrect alt text and heavy assets, then pairs corrected descriptions with sitemap work and measured file sizes. These are concrete fixes for accessibility, discovery and page weight.
Auditing alt text and serving WebP assets improves Google Image rankings and significantly reduces first contentful paint across mobile connections.

The audit already found 22 of 26 homepage images carrying accurate alt text, so this is precision work on a known list of specific defects, and the image sitemap and WebP steps are measurable rather than aspirational.

acceptedWorkstreams.description: Most marketing images come from shared components in zedu-fe (src/app/(homepage)/_components), so the alt text is set in a few files, not per page. Live alt texts on 22 Oct 2026 include 'Logo', 'twitter icon' and 'Preview of the learning communication interface' repeated across sections. acceptedWorkstreams.description: Audits and shared-component fixes clean up what exists today; new PRs reintroduce the same defects. The one-time audit becomes a standing rule the repo itself applies.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Serve share images from a Zedu path, not 'telexprodbucket'
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Every share image URL on zedu.chat contains the old product name. src/lib/env-urls.ts builds it as `${NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDIA_URL}/telexprodbucket/public/og-images/${fileName}`, so the live twitter:image is https://media.zedu.chat/telexprodbucket/public/og-images/og-image-5.png (200, 159,782 bytes, checked 22 Oct 2026). Link previews and image search show that path. Plan: copy the og-images to a zedu-named prefix on the media host, change the one helper, keep the old path working so cached previews don't break, and list every page whose og:image changes.
